method: Postprocessing for restaurant category only: one clause, at most 30 words, exactly one matched aspect, one clear uncontradicted explicit cue. Does not alter saved model weights.
product_inference: unchanged because correction is applied only when Restaurants is selected

demonstration.review_flag: Explicit restaurant cue differs from model

limitations: Very small number of changed held-out predictions; previously inspected evaluation sets; not evidence of a general restaurant accuracy gain. Mixed, neutral, long, unfamiliar and implicit sentiment can still be wrong. Restaurant cue is a rule, not a second model.
